name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
about: FSN E-commerce Ventures Ltd. (FSNEV) popularly known as "Nykaa" is a digitally native consumer technology platform, delivering a content-led, lifestyle retail experience to consumers. The company has a diverse portfolio of beauty, personal care, and fashion products, including owned brand products manufactured by it. [1]

sections.one_liner: Nykaa sells beauty and fashion online and offline. Revenue grows ~29% with 8.5% EBITDA margin, but the stock trades at 377x earnings.
business: Beauty is 85% of FY26 net revenue: NSV ₹8,504cr, +27% YoY, 45M customers, 4,400+ brands [AR FY26]
Fashion & Lifestyle is the other 15%. Q1FY27 NSV was ₹451cr, +54% YoY, and the segment only just broke even at 0.1% EBITDA [AR FY26][Q1FY27 call]
Four channels: app/web marketplace, 324 stores, Nykaa Now quick delivery in 13 cities, Superstore B2B with 523k retailers [Q1FY27 call]
House of Nykaa owned brands: FY26 GMV ₹3,176cr (~32% of NR-equivalent scale). Dot & Key alone was ₹1,790cr [Q4FY26 call]
financial_snapshot: Q1FY27: revenue ₹2,782cr (+29.1% YoY), EBITDA ₹236cr (8.5%), PAT ₹80cr (2.9% margin) [Numbers]
TTM: revenue ₹10,649cr, EBITDA ₹848cr (8.0%), PAT ₹260cr (2.4%). Only 31% of EBITDA reaches PAT [Numbers]
ROCE 17.2% and ROE 15.3%, up from a 6% ROCE trough in FY23 [Numbers]
Market cap ₹1,00,465cr: 377x P/E, ~70x book, ~120x TTM EBITDA (with debt), 0.5% FCF yield. Price ₹351 is near the ₹354 high [Numbers]
trajectory: Revenue CAGR is 24.9% over 3 years. Quarterly YoY growth sped up every quarter, from 23.4% (Jun-25) to 29.1% (Jun-26) [Numbers]
EBITDA went from ₹257cr to ₹753cr (FY23→FY26), a ~43% CAGR. Each extra rupee of FY26 revenue earned a 13.4% EBITDA margin [Numbers]
OPM rose from 5.0% in FY24 to 8.0% in FY26 but has been flat at 8% for three quarters. The margin gains may be levelling off [Numbers]
Owned-brand growth is slowing: 54% (Q2FY26), 48% (Q3), 50% (FY26), 36% (Q1FY27). The Q1FY27 figure is NSV, not GMV [Q2FY26–Q1FY27 calls]
balance_sheet: Borrowings went from ₹798cr to ₹1,238cr (FY23→FY26). D/E peaked at 1.02 in FY25 and fell to 0.86 in FY26 [Numbers]
Net worth rose only ₹137cr in FY26 while PAT was ₹204cr. The ₹67cr gap is not disclosed [Numbers]
Cash conversion cycle fell from 106 to 71 days and inventory days from 150 to 109, which freed working capital [Numbers]
cash_quality: Over FY24–26, operating cash flow was 3.52x PAT (₹1,111cr vs ₹316cr). Profits turn into cash, and PAT understates cash earnings [Numbers]
FCF went from –₹348cr (FY23) to +₹493cr (FY26). Capex was about ₹151cr in FY26 [Numbers]
FY24–26 FCF totalled ₹722cr, yet borrowings rose ₹269cr. Where the cash went is not disclosed [Numbers]
narrative_vs_numbers: They agree: management's FY26 figures (7.5% EBITDA margin, 183% PAT growth) match the reported numbers exactly [Q4FY26 call][Numbers]
Q3 analysts feared the festive-quarter margin wouldn't last. OPM held at 8% in Q4 and Q1FY27, supporting the 'no one-offs' claim [Q3FY26 call][Numbers]
Beauty orders fell 1% QoQ and grew 20% YoY against 29% NSV growth. Growth is coming from order value as much as order count [Q1FY27 call]
Management says Nykaa Now causes 'no margin dilution', but it plans more Nykaa Now marketing and group EBITDA margin was flat QoQ (8.4%→8.5%) [Q1FY27 call][Q4FY26 call]
guidance: Nykaa Now to grow from 13 to 25+ cities by the end of FY27 [Q1FY27 call]
Fashion revenue/GMV to grow 3–3.5x over 4–5 years, kept after the Nike deal [Q1FY27 call]
Superstore to reach 35%+ NSV CAGR by FY2030. The GST drag is expected to normalise from Q3FY27 [Q1FY27 call]
FY27 store openings to match FY26 (~50–70 doors), working towards 500 beauty stores over 3–4 years [Q4FY26 call]
No explicit consolidated EBITDA margin guidance. Management avoided giving a number [Q3FY26 call]

ledger.promised: Strong Q3 from Pink Friday and Nykaaland [Q2FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: Revenue ₹2,873cr, +22.5% QoQ, +26.7% YoY. Then-record OPM of 8% [Numbers]

ledger.promised: GST hit to Superstore turns positive in coming weeks/months [Q2FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: Q1FY27 call still cites the GST drag and now pushes normalisation to Q3FY27. Superstore growth slowed from 31% to 28%

ledger.promised: Fashion 'well on path towards profitability' [Q2FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: Fashion EBITDA margin +0.3% in Q4FY26 and +0.1% in Q1FY27, up from –3.5%

ledger.promised: Fashion margins keep improving from the +0.3% Q4 baseline [Q4FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: Q1FY27 fashion margin 0.1%, down QoQ but up from –14.1% YoY

ledger.promised: Stores present in the top 100 cities [Q2FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: 324 stores across 100+ cities by Q1FY27 [Q1FY27 call]

ledger.promised: Open ~50–70 stores, similar to FY26 [Q4FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: 11 stores added in Q1FY27, a ~44/year pace. Back-half catch-up needed
13 cities at Q1FY27. 12 more needed in three quarters

ledger.promised: Full-stack D2C services for Kiehl's India [Q3FY26 call]
ledger.delivered: Kiehl's not mentioned in the Q4FY26 or Q1FY27 extractions

bull: Revenue growth sped up for four straight quarters to 29.1%, and EBITDA grew faster at 68% YoY in Q1FY27 [Numbers]
Each extra rupee of Q1FY27 revenue earned a ~15% EBITDA margin, nearly double the 8.5% current margin. That leaves room for further margin gains [Numbers]
FCF of ₹493cr is 2.4x PAT and the cash cycle is down 35 days since FY23, so growth funds itself [Numbers]
bear: 377x P/E and 0.5% FCF yield. Even doubling PAT leaves the stock near 190x [Numbers]
Group margin has been flat at 8% for three quarters while Nykaa Now marketing ramps up in FY27 [Numbers][Q4FY26 call]
Owned-brand growth slowed from 54% to 36%, and Fashion growth depends on Nike. Margin drivers look less certain [Q1FY27 call][Q2FY26 call]
questions: FCF was ₹722cr over three years, yet debt rose ₹269cr. Where did the cash go?
Why did net worth rise ₹137cr when FY26 PAT was ₹204cr?
How much did Nykaa Now cost in Q1FY27, and what is FY27 marketing spend?
Owned-brand growth fell to 36%: is this Dot & Key slowing, and why switch to NSV?

annual_report.business: India's leading omnichannel beauty and lifestyle platform combining commerce, content, community. Operates digital marketplace (10,000+ brands), 313 retail stores, B2B network (500k retailers). Generates revenue through product margins, B2B commissions, owned brands. Serves 55M+ customers.

segments.name: Fashion & Lifestyle
segments.comment: Part of total NR ₹10,022cr, expanding portfolio

annual_report.revenue_mix: Geography: Tier 2/3 cities ~60% of beauty sales. Product: Beauty 85%, Fashion 15%. Customer: Primarily B2C (55M), with B2B through Superstore (500k retailers).
strategy: Expand brand partnerships (10,000+ brands, 200+ launches FY26)
Scale omnichannel: 313 stores, digital, B2B channels
Grow House of Nykaa owned brands (₹3,176cr GMV)
Enhance personalization through technology and data insights
annual_report.outlook: Limited explicit forward guidance in opening pages. Implicit confidence in category expansion and omnichannel scalability shown by record 76 store openings FY2026. Market tailwinds from rising aspirations and digital-first discovery.
annual_report.capex_plans: Retail expansion: 76 stores opened FY2026 (record). 15 Nykaa Luxe stores and dedicated Perfumery stores planned. Specific capex amounts not disclosed.
